15 days · Tangier → Tangier

North to the Desert

Welcome at the port of Tangier and a journey into the Rif, down to the desert and back along the Atlantic coast.

Request a booking
15 days
Tangier → Tangier
Riads + desert camp
4x4 with guide
  1. Day1

    Tangier – Chefchaouen

    Welcome at the port of Tangier. We start the journey into the Rif and arrive in Chefchaouen in the afternoon. Chefchaouen is a Berber town whose name means "the horns", beautifully set where the white of its terraced houses contrasts with the green fields watered by the Lau river. Overnight in a riad.

  2. Day2

    Chefchaouen – Fez

    Breakfast and, after a visit to the town, departure for Fez, a beautiful city founded in the 8th century. Fez is the oldest of the Moroccan imperial cities, with a medina that takes us back to the 13th century, its craftsmen grouped by street and trade like the old guilds. Overnight in a charming riad inside the medina.

  3. Day3

    Fez – Volubilis – Meknes – Azrou

    Morning visit to the city of Fez, the cultural capital of Morocco. After lunch, asphalt road to the Roman ruins of Volubilis. A walk through the Roman city and arrival in Meknes: visit to the city (the tomb of Moulay Ismail, el-Hedim square, Bab Mansour) and on to the town of Azrou in the Middle Atlas. Dinner and overnight in a riad.

  4. Day4

    Azrou – Errachidia – Merzouga

    We leave Azrou for Merzouga through the cedar forest, the Midelt pass, the Errachidia reservoir, the magnificent panorama of the Ziz valley and the town of Erfoud, the gateway to the desert. We watch the sunset from the top of Borj d'Est with a wonderful view over Erfoud, then continue by track at night to the dunes of Erg Chebbi. Overnight at Riad Madu, at the foot of the dunes.

  5. Day5

    Erg Chebbi (Merzouga)

    After breakfast we go around the dunes by track: the two oases of Merzouga, the nomads in their tents, the village of Khamlia, the Mifiss mines, the desert plateaus and the Tissardmine oasis. Back around 3 p.m. Later we ride dromedaries into the dunes to watch the sunset and sleep in a wild oasis in the heart of the dunes. A magical night!

  6. Day6

    Erg Chebbi – Taouz – Rissani – Merzouga

    Back from the desert we take the track to Taouz to discover the prehistoric engravings. Then to Rissani, the ancient Sijilmasa, an important centre on the caravan routes trading with Mali and Niger. We visit its famous gate, the old palaces and the souk. At noon we eat the local speciality, Saharan pizza. In the afternoon we visit the fossil quarry and return to the riad.

  7. Day7

    Merzouga – Todra Gorge – Dades Gorge

    From the dunes towards Erfoud to Tinghir, where we visit the foggaras (15th-century water channels) and the palm grove. We reach the Todra Gorge for lunch, then cross the town and the Boumalne Dades valley to the Dades Gorge, where the river has carved the rock into a peculiar landscape. Overnight in a riad.

  8. Day8

    Dades – Boutaghrar – Skoura – Ouarzazate

    By track to the Valley of the Roses and the magnificent Berber village of Boutaghrar, where we have tea with a family. We follow the track along the Route of a Thousand Kasbahs, a stage off the usual circuit, with stops at kasbahs, viewpoints, valleys and nomads living in caves. Arrival at Skoura and road to Ouarzazate, famous for its film studios. Overnight in a riad.

  9. Day9

    Ouarzazate – Telouet – Marrakech

    We visit the splendid kasbah of Ait Benhaddou, where films such as Lawrence of Arabia and The Mummy were shot. Then across the mountain to the Telouet kasbah. In the late afternoon we return to Marrakech over one of the most beautiful passes in Morocco, the Tizi n'Tichka (2,260 m). Overnight in a riad.

  10. Day10

    Marrakech

    Visit to the city of Marrakech with its old medina, its main historical monuments, its kasbahs and the famous Jemaa el Fna square. Overnight in the same riad.

  11. Day11

    Marrakech – Essaouira

    Morning walk through the new town of Marrakech and, after lunch, departure for the small fishing port of Essaouira on the Atlantic coast, with more than 11 km of beach. Overnight in a riad.

  12. Day12

    Essaouira

    In the city we can see the museum of wooden crafts in an old palace, the old watchtower and the Skala of the port, overlooking the coast, the islands and the whole city, the Marine Gate and the fish auction at the harbour. The narrow streets of the medina showcase the work of jewellers, goldsmiths and cedar and ebony marquetry craftsmen in the workshops of the city bastions. Overnight in a riad.

  13. Day13

    Essaouira – Safi – Rabat

    Breakfast and departure along the coast to Rabat, the administrative and political capital. We see the diplomatic quarter, the Royal Palace, the Mohammed V mausoleum and the Hassan Tower. Overnight in a riad.

  14. Day14

    Rabat – Larache – Asilah

    Along the coast to Asilah, a jewel of Hispano-Moorish architecture. A small town and fishing port that grew under the Spanish protectorate, enclosed by ochre Portuguese walls, its houses with blue, green and yellow doors and windows against white walls. Overnight in a riad.

  15. Day15

    Asilah – Tangier – Algeciras

    Breakfast and transfer to the port of Tangier to board the ferry to Algeciras.
